title: Null control: London precip vs SPY
hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] NULL CONTROL: London daily precipitation has no lead-lag relation to S&P returns at 0-5 days (0); no trade, benchmark for false positives [weather.london.precip -> finance.SPY.log_return]
message: Null control passed: London precip vs SPY log return r=-0.014 (n=387), best lag -1d r=-0.066, perm p=0.68, Bonferroni p=1.0; trade rule Sharpe -0.94, OOS hit 20%. No signal, as expected.

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.london.precip rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short SPY next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
